say:3:1421143001:1.text: Hahaha! Splendid, right? I bet you've never seen Indris drunk before! It's quite the sight, I must say.
say:3:1421143001:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈，怎么样，怎么样！没见过吧！这就是了不起的，...

say:4:1421143002:1.text: He can't hold his liquor. Every time he gets drunk, he clings to things and won't let go.
say:4:1421143002:1.source_cn: 他很容易喝醉，一喝醉就抱着东西摸来摸去不撒手。

say:5:1421143003:1.text: The problem is, he's so strong that few can pry him off! So, those poor souls just have to wait until he sobers up.
say:5:1421143003:1.source_cn: 因为力气太大，被他抱住的话好几个人都掰不开，只能被他一...

say:6:1421143004:1.text: Only the victims and I know about this side of him! It's definitely an exclusive scoop!
say:6:1421143004:1.source_cn: 这可是只有我与极其少数的受害者才知道的秘闻，时至今日，...

say:7:1421143005:1.text: ... So, Indris rarely drinks not because of self-discipline, but because he can't handle alcohol...
say:7:1421143005:1.source_cn: ……因度厄他滴酒不沾，居然不是自律，是因为酒量太差吗……

say:8:1421143006:1.text: As you know, he's quite a perfectionist and never allows himself to have a weakness.
say:8:1421143006:1.source_cn: 啊，那倒不是，他这人你知道，越是短处就越要锻炼。

say:9:1421143007:1.text: So, when everyone found out about his poor tolerance for alcohol, he decided to work hard to improve it.
say:9:1421143007:1.source_cn: 酒量差这事一出来，他就决定要好好练练，让自己不留下短板。

say:10:1421143008:1.source_cn: 但是吧，这不是有我在吗！

say:11:1421143009:1.text: This is what I do—every time he drank, I'd pull that move on him until he couldn't take it anymore, and he would give up. Pretty amazing, isn't it?
say:11:1421143009:1.source_cn: 他只要一喝酒我就这么来一套，导致后来他忍无可忍含恨放弃...

choice_prompt:12:1421143009.text: This is what I do—every time he drank, I'd pull that move on him until he couldn't take it anymore, and he would give up. Pretty amazing, isn't it?
choice_prompt:12:1421143009.source_cn: 他只要一喝酒我就这么来一套，导致后来他忍无可忍含恨放弃了这项锻炼——怎么样，我厉害吧？

say:13:1421143010:1.text: I'll take that as a compliment! Getting such an aspiring man to give up on self-improvement—now that's a huge achievement!
say:13:1421143010:1.source_cn: 多谢夸奖，能让这么个死心眼又努力的家伙放弃自我提升，是...
say:13:1421143010:1.male: I'll take that as a compliment! Getting such an aspiring man to give up on self-improvement—now that's a huge achievement!
say:13:1421143010:1.female: I'll take that as a compliment! Getting such an aspiring man to give up on self-improvement—now that's a huge achievement!

say:14:1421143012:1.text: What do you say now, Otivia? Still holding Indris up on a pedestal?
say:14:1421143012:1.source_cn: 所以，可爱的小花朵，怎么样？这个独家新闻有没有让你失去...

say:15:1421143013:1.text: Actually, I never worshipped him to begin with! He's just someone I deeply respect and look up to.
say:15:1421143013:1.source_cn: 我本来也没有崇拜因度厄大人啦！我对他更多的是尊敬与向往而已！

say:16:1421143014:1.text: You see, I've been taking notes this whole time, and there's something I'd like to ask you...
say:16:1421143014:1.source_cn: 但是呢，我刚刚一直在记录，所以有个问题想请教沙利叶大人……

say:18:1421143016:1.text: It's about this hugging habit that he has every time he gets drunk...
say:18:1421143016:1.source_cn: 就是，您说因度厄大人一旦喝酒就会抱着人不撒手，一直要抱...

say:19:1421143017:1.text: Since you mentioned it's an <style="highlight">exclusive scoop</style>, can I take that to mean that you're the one he's hugged the most?
say:19:1421143017:1.source_cn: 又说这是现在的<style=highlight>独家新...

say:21:1421143019:1.text: Oh, I get it now! You've been sacrificing yourself for the greater good all this time!
say:21:1421143019:1.source_cn: 哇哦，沙利叶统领，我明白了，原来你一直是建立在牺牲自我...

say:22:1421143020:1.text: Such a selfless spirit! I wouldn't expect anything less from the pioneer who recruited commoners into the guard!
say:22:1421143020:1.source_cn: 真是无私的精神，不愧是率先打破传统，顶着压力让平民加入...

say:23:1421143021:1.text: ... No, wait, stop it. I might start believing you if you keep going, Otivia...
say:23:1421143021:1.source_cn: ……不，不不，等等等等，席蕾也就算了，欧蒂薇你可别这样...

say:24:1421143022:1.text: I really mean it, Imperator! Seems like everyone in Sal'thorin has misunderstood you!
say:24:1421143022:1.source_cn: 我是在真心赞美您的，沙利叶大人！萨洛克兰的人都误解您了！

say:25:1421143023:1.text: By sacrificing yourself, you've become crucial support for Captain Indris on his journey to greatness!
say:25:1421143023:1.source_cn: 您一直牺牲自我，从最初的贵族身份，到之后的声名与职责，...

say:26:1421143024:1.text: The friendship between Captain Indris and you is truly exemplary—
say:26:1421143024:1.source_cn: 正如您所说的，您与因度厄大人，是真挚的友情，不可取代的...

say:27:1421143025:1.text: Oh, please stop before I throw up, Otivia. I assure you, that guy... I mean, Imperator Ravion is nothing like what you're saying!
say:27:1421143025:1.source_cn: 行了行了，再说就有点恶心了，欧蒂薇，我跟你保证，那家伙...

narration:29:1421143026:0.text: Just then, Indris, now without anything in his arms, starts shuffling over... Ravion immediately urges everyone to leave...
narration:29:1421143026:0.source_cn: 话还没说完，失去怀抱物的因度厄再次摇摇晃晃地走了过来…...

narration:30:1421143027:0.text: The minstrels come together again the following day...
narration:30:1421143027:0.source_cn: 但第二日，吟游诗人小分队再度被召集了起来……

say:32:1421143011:1.text: I'll take that as a compliment. Indris doesn't see it that way and sometimes even retaliates with violence, but I'm glad you're on my side!
say:32:1421143011:1.source_cn: 我就当做是夸奖了。虽然因度厄对此极为不认可并偶尔回以暴...
say:32:1421143011:1.male: I'll take that as a compliment. Indris doesn't see it that way and sometimes even retaliates with violence, but I'm glad you're on my side!
say:32:1421143011:1.female: I'll take that as a compliment. Indris doesn't see it that way and sometimes even retaliates with violence, but I'm glad you're on my side!
